annotations.text:
Four ways to give the dark rail the edge the light one has — elevation, geometry, a literal mirror, and removing the slab.

Read the bottom section first if you have time for one thing: the black rail you're picturing is in docs/design/ink, not in NavRail.tsx. It was designed and never built, in either theme.

B at full size, directly above what ships today — same content, same 1440×900, so the two stack for comparison.

In B the chrome strip loses its fill and its rule: the search field, bell and avatar become raised chips on the page, so the rail is not the only floating object.

Reference from the first pass — the rail at both widths 1:1, and the four things the dark walk turned up.

Direction A fixes the first of those for free: a #202023 rail makes the #2A2A2E hover visible again.
